name: groove
description: Coding work end to end with only what the task needs: plan when it is big, write, cut, and prove it with the cheapest check.

interface.shortDescription: Coding work with only what the task needs
interface.longDescription: Groove handles coding work end to end. It writes a one-file plan only when the work is too big to do and check in one go, names a caller before writing anything new, cuts what is not needed before finishing, keeps tests to a few seconds, and reports with counted numbers.
defaultPrompt: Use Groove to fix this bug.
Use Groove to plan and build this project.
